decisions: Minutes from the May 9, 2025 board meeting approved as amended with corrected Q1 revenue figure of $4.28M.

Formal collections proceedings approved for two delinquent client accounts exceeding 75 days; Pierre Dubois to coordinate with outside counsel by June 13, 2025. Third account granted a 15-day grace period.
Aiyana Park to deliver Northwind Partners warehouse throughput optimization report by June 23, 2025 with weekly client updates to Daniel Yuen.
Pierre Dubois to prepare Northwind Partners contract renewal and upsell proposal (target value minimum $1.1M annually) by July 18, 2025.
Margaret Holvan to schedule executive-level meeting with Northwind Partners leadership for the week of July 28, 2025.
Four senior consultant positions and one project coordinator role approved for immediate posting by June 16, 2025; target start date August 4, 2025.
Pierre Dubois to complete compensation benchmarking analysis for retention purposes by June 27, 2025.
Velotrack Enterprise selected as new project management and client reporting platform; vendor agreement to be executed by June 20, 2025; implementation to begin by July 7, 2025.
Aiyana Park to submit speaking proposal to Northeast Advisory Summit by June 13, 2025; travel arrangements for Holvan and Dubois to be coordinated by June 20, 2025.
